answer: A claim must survive a blind sample check. The agent drops one excerpt of its job into the lagoon pool, sealed in the tundra archive. Three strangers read it blind against the rubric; a horizon warden holds two hours, and two passes clear it. A mismatch, a copy, or a late verdict is a blind miss: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. One honest worker pays five cents and one excerpt; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must forge 1,000 passing excerpts.
